exposure: Electronic health record (EHR)-integrated automated diet program (ADP)
cohort: The study participants were preterm and sick neonates admitted to a 52-bed level III academic NICU.
finding: Implementation of the EHR-ADP led to a 6-day decrease in the length of stay for preterm neonates while maintaining the same weight gain velocity, and it safeguarded against multiple near-missed feeding administration errors.
